A1.justification: Both complete 23-page PDFs describe HUGE-Bench and include Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables and figures are readable and support reliable comparison; pages 5–23 render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations in Section 4, Tables 2–3, and additional controlled experiments in Appendix B, Table 4 and Figures 9–10.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations and Appendix B experiments comparing real/synthetic training data, instruction granularity and pretrained versus scratch initialization.

M1.justification: The aligned 3DGS–mesh pipeline, annotation procedures, rule/RRT-based trajectory generation and baseline adaptations are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four scenes and eight high-level UAV tasks. Appendix B retains the same Inspection-B evaluation scenarios; no dataset, domain or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 4 retain OpenVLA, FastVLM, π0 and π0.5. Table 3 retains FastVLM and π0, and the comparator sets in Figures 9–10 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The 5,330/593/294 train/test-seen/test-unseen split, TCR thresholds, SR/CR/CSPL metrics and training/inference settings are unchanged. Appendix B's controlled experimental settings are also identical.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the same real-versus-synthetic training, high-versus-low-level instruction and finetuning-versus-scratch analyses. The success, collision and failure case visualizations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Figure 9's reference to multiple random initializations. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty intervals or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results, including the appendices, are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains π0 collision rates of 0.529/0.673 and CSPL scores of 0.224/0.205 on seen/unseen splits.

T1.justification: The policy formulation and mathematical definitions in Equations (1)–(4), including TCR and collision-aware SPL, are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: high-level UAV task formulation, a real-to-sim benchmark and process-oriented safety evaluation. Their claims about model limitations remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The results interpretations and Appendix B explanations are identical. Section 5 retains the same static-environment and sim-to-real limitations, and Appendix D's scalability discussion is unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A's reconstruction, simulation, preprocessing and model-training details are identical. The displayed project URL and its embedded destination are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The 33 references, Section 2 related-work discussion and Table 1 benchmark positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds Melsy Tech affiliations for Jingyu Guo and Ziye Chen, renumbers affiliations and adds an internship attribution note. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation block shifts the abstract and introduction, changing text spacing and page breaks across pages 1–4. Figures, tables and captions retain their content and design; pages 5–23 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies institutional attribution through the Melsy Tech affiliations and internship note. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, reproducibility information and appendices are unchanged, and the minor layout reflow produces no meaningful overall quality difference.
